lines.en: I march with stiff steps

lines.zh: 青色从我脸上一直涂到脚
lines.en: Cyan is painted from my face to my feet

lines.zh: 我的身体一块一块拼起来
lines.en: My body is pieced together in blocks

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下粉痕
lines.en: Powder marks follow where I walk
My weapon is held out before me

lines.zh: 我是被捏出来又活过来的
lines.en: I was shaped, then brought to life
I have no expression, only a direction
I march to the front of the line

lines.zh: 我的关节发出土的声音
lines.en: My joints make a clay sound

lines.zh: 我接着队列的位置往前走
lines.en: I keep my place in the line and advance

lines.zh: 我的脚踩出土印才抬起
lines.en: My feet leave prints before they lift

lines.zh: 我从战场这一边走到那一边
lines.en: I cross from one side of the field to the other
I stand like a small idol
My arms are still raised

lines.zh: 我在等谁给我一句命令
lines.en: I wait for someone to give an order
A fine dust coats my surface
I hold my post without moving
My color stands out

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，只等一句号令。
lines.en: I don't breathe; I wait for a command.
I listen to fighting far off
My feet sink a little into the soil
Have you come to command me
I know those shaping hands
Who do you want me to fight

lines.zh: 你身上没有黏土的味道
lines.en: You do not smell of clay
I can take a blow for you
Did you paint me cyan
I do not choose my own direction
Say one word and I move
I watch you, waiting for the order

lines.zh: 我的眼睛只是两个凹坑
lines.en: My eyes are only two hollows

lines.zh: 你站的位置在我要走的路线上
lines.en: You are standing on my route

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我被造出来不怕
lines.en: I do not fear you, I was made not to
A piece of me fell off
A crack opened in my body
That one landed solidly
A patch of my color came off
I do not hurt, I am only lighter
My weapon is still in my hand
I square up again
A small piece fell from my chest
I cannot eat any of it
Handing that to me is useless
I am made all of clay
This is of no use to me
Even on the ground I will not touch it
My mouth is only painted on
I am not hungry, and cannot be
Eat your own ration
I am waiting for your order
I cannot bend to take it

lines.zh: 我的一小块土掉了下来
lines.en: A small piece of clay fell off me
Your hand touched my dust
I turn my shoulder back
This does not affect my fighting
I realign myself
I raise my arm to guard my chest

lines.zh: 我被撞得向后滑了半格
lines.en: I slid back half a block from the impact

lines.zh: 当心脚下，黏土也是会疼的。
lines.en: Mind your step — clay can feel pain too.
I was shaped by hands

lines.zh: 我的同类都从同一块土来
lines.en: My kind all come from the same clay
I turn my face back to the line
I have no such thoughts
I stand back at my original angle
None of my batch look at one another
All our time goes to fighting

lines.zh: 两块黏土合在一起，也能生出新兵。
lines.en: Two lumps of clay can still make a new recruit.
I can hand this to my master
I tuck it under my arm

lines.zh: 地上掉的东西我都要收
lines.en: I must gather whatever falls
I do not understand what use it has
Let me carry this for you

lines.zh: 这把木棍，正好给我换把武器。
lines.en: This stick will do nicely as a new weapon.

lines.zh: 捡起来，我就多一分活命的甲。
lines.en: Pick it up and I gain a bit more armor.

lines.zh: 青色染料？我本来就是这个色。
lines.en: Cyan dye? I already come in this color.
An enemy has appeared ahead
I raise my weapon
I square up to that direction
I have no need to think
I begin to step
My cyan is brighter in the light
Leave this target to me
Its direction has changed
I turned my body to face it
I count how many steps remain
I raise my weapon to my shoulder
I will hold this patch
I have no other thoughts
Cyan as I am, I walk steady.
I have no intention of retreating

lines.zh: 我的武器一直指向前方
lines.en: My weapon stays pointed forward

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方土都碎了
lines.en: The soil crumbles where I step
I neither shout nor pant
My joints are a little loose
It retreats, I advance

lines.zh: 我在等它进入我的距离
lines.en: I wait for it to enter my reach

lines.zh: 我的武器已经举到肩头。
lines.en: My weapon is up at my shoulder.
I watch its movements
My steps have slowed
My hands do not shake at all
I am only two blocks from it
I plant my feet hard
I swing my weapon down

lines.zh: 这一下用的是全身的土
lines.en: I put all my clay into it
My arm strikes straight
I break its guard
I return to position after the strike
My weapon chipped
I raise it again
This is not for winning
I ram with my shoulder
My weapon comes down from above

lines.zh: 这一击带着土块的重量
lines.en: This blow carries the weight of the clay
I shove it back two blocks
I pull back and strike again
I strike its flank
My movements are slow but solid

lines.zh: 我砸完这一下，退回队列。
lines.en: I land the blow and step back into line.

lines.zh: 我从手里的一块土站起来
lines.en: I rise from a lump of clay in your hand
I land with a dull thud
My color is freshly painted
I wait for your first order
The clay on me is still damp
I can stand a long while
This is not far from the fight
I look toward the enemy

lines.zh: 我是黏土士兵，青色这一批
lines.en: I am a Clay Soldier, of the cyan batch
I wait to be set on the ground
Fingerprints are still on me
I will be moving in a moment
Fire cracked my surface

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，碎了一角
lines.en: I fell from height and broke a corner

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的土在动
lines.en: That magic made my clay stir
I have no stomach to go hungry.

lines.zh: 雷把我的土烧成了硬块
lines.en: Lightning baked my clay hard
The ground under me did not hold
